summary.text: On Ravnica, planeswalkers conjure replicas of old allies as reminders of the homeworlds that would fall next if Bolas prevailed, while Dovin Baan orders New Prahv sealed and planeswalker activity reported.
Gideon Jura asks a pegasus whether it would give its life to save the world, while the Conclave's falcons scout Vitu-Ghazi, New Prahv and Orzhova.
The arrival of the Planar Bridge causes eddies in the aether, creating some entirely new species while transforming others.
